April    7        37.

My dear Hill,

    With reference to your letter dated
2nd April, 1937, I have to inform you that the
Municipal Police have no record of an Irishman
named John McVittie Taylor Moresby.  Enquiries
at shipping companies, etc. have failed to show
that Moresby has ever visited Shanghai.

                Yours sincerely,

                (Sd) K. M. Bourne.

F. L. Hill, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

1937年4月7日。

亲爱的希尔：

关于您1937年4月2日的来信，兹通知您，工部局警务处并无名为约翰·麦克维蒂·泰勒·莫尔斯比（John McVittie Taylor Moresby）的爱尔兰人的记录。经向轮船公司等机构查询，均未发现莫尔斯比曾到访上海的记录。

此致

敬礼

（签名）K. M. 伯恩

F. L. 希尔 先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............

REPORT
Date April 6, 19 ' 37.

Subject J.M.T. Moresby, Communication from British Consulate General

Made by D.P.S. Henchman    Forwarded by [Signature] D.C.I.

With reference to the attached communication, I have to
state that there is nothing in S.M.P. records concerning John
McVittie Taylor Moresby. Enquiries at outside sources, shipping
companies, etc. fail to show that Moresby has on any occasion
visited Shanghai.

[Signature]
D. P. S.

o.f.
D.C.(Special Branch)

[Signature]

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O. BOX 259. SHANGHAI.

Secret & Personal.

2nd April 1937.

Dear Bourne,

I shall be grateful if you will kindly let me
know whether you have anything on record concerning one John
McVittie Taylor Moresby, an Irishman, born in Dublin on
6.5.1906, who has travelled in the Far East on a Foreign
Office passport issued in London on 8.6.26. valid till 8.6.31
and renewed at H.B.M's Consulate-General, Yokohama, valid
till 8.6.1936.

Yours Sincerely,
〔此处为手写签名〕

Major K.M. Bourne M.C.,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Foochow Road,
Shanghai.

S1
〔此处有圆形印章，内含文字及“CHANGHAI”字样〕

D. G. S. Henchman.
J.L. 3/4 D.R.

英国驻上海总领事馆，
邮政信箱 259，上海。

机密且私人。

1937年4月2日。

亲爱的伯恩：

如蒙告知贵处是否有关于约翰·麦克维蒂·泰勒·莫尔斯比的档案记录，我将不胜感激。此人系爱尔兰人，1906年5月6日出生于都柏林，持有一本由伦敦于1926年6月8日签发、有效期至1931年6月8日，并在英国驻横滨总领事馆续期、有效期至1936年6月8日的外交部护照，曾在远东旅行。

此致

敬礼
〔此处为手写签名〕

K.M. 伯恩 少校，军功十字勋章获得者，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
福州路，
上海。

S1
〔此处有圆形印章，内含文字及“CHANGHAI”字样〕

D. G. S. 亨奇曼。
